long_description:
Alex is an agentic AI recruiter for the future of hiring. Companies use us to get the best hiring signal on their applicant pool and hire in a fraction of the time.

Our AI recruiter, Alex, has a live conversation over a video call with each of your candidates based on the interview questions you choose or that are recommended based on the job description. During the interview, Alex asks personalized follow-up questions in real-time based on the candidate's responses.

Alex can be customized to your roles in minutes and has already conducted thousands of interviews across engineering, IT, retail, hospitality, and more.
name: Alex
one_liner: Your AI recruiter for interviewing and identifying the best talent
